'''Taweelah B Power and Desalination Station''' (B محطة الطويلة) is an operating power station of at least 2254-megawatts (MW) in Al Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
It is also known as Taweelah B Integrated Water and Power Plant.
